name: Biển Hồ
kicker: Volcanic crater lake north of Pleiku
summary: Walk the shore of Biển Hồ, a crater lake about 7 km north of Pleiku. Come at first light, while mist is still on the water. The tea slopes are the same northern loop, so keep them with the lake. Skip it if you wanted a sea swim. Boat hire and any shore ticket are Check on arrival.
getThere: About 7 km north of Pleiku, off Phạm Văn Đồng onto Tôn Đức Thắng
heroCaption: Hồ T’Nưng from the forested rim, with the water filling the frame

notice.title: This is a lake, not a beach
notice.body: Biển Hồ is freshwater, left by extinct volcanoes. Come for the shore and the mist. A sea swim is the wrong plan.

body: Turn off Phạm Văn Đồng, Quốc lộ 14, at the Biển Hồ junction and follow Tôn Đức Thắng to the water. The lake sits about 7 km north of Pleiku. It is a trace of three extinct volcanoes, freshwater, not a beach. Walk the shore and the viewpoints. The tea slopes are the same northern loop: about 12 km from town, left off Quốc lộ 14 onto Lê Văn Sỹ for about 3 km, then along the irrigation dam road. Stay off the harvest paths.

Come while mist is still on the water. November to April are the drier months on these highland roads. Chu Đăng Ya, about 30 km northeast, is the other crater if the afternoon is dry. That rim is about 500 m above sea level, and the path up from Ploi lagri village has steep, slippery sections. The lake is the morning. The volcano is the longer ride.

figures.caption: The same lake from the pine shore
figures.alt: Pine trunks framing Biển Hồ, with the far forested shore across the water

gettingThere: The lake is north of Pleiku. From the center, follow Phạm Văn Đồng, Quốc lộ 14, to the Biển Hồ junction, then Tôn Đức Thắng to the shore. The distance is about 7 km. Minutes and the fare are Check on arrival.

legs.heading: From Pleiku
legs.body: By taxi or ride-hail, then walk the shore. About 7 km north, with the turn from Phạm Văn Đồng onto Tôn Đức Thắng. Minutes and the fare are Check on arrival.

admissionNote: Boat hire and any shore ticket are Check on arrival. No child rule or inclusion list is set out.
